name: JF SmartInvest Holdings Ltd
summary: JF SmartInvest Holdings Ltd, an investment holding company, through its subsidiaries, provides online investment decision-making solution services in the People's Republic of China. The company operates through Internet financial software sales and services seg, and AI terminal products segments. It offers financial software sales and services, including market data processing, data analysis, prerecorded online investor education courses, livestreaming broadcasts, online investment decision-making support, express market reviews, and indicator analysis tools, as well as various online high-end premium services.
